text_block_list.text:
On the way home after going out with Nishino Flower.
As we were passing by the station—

text_block_list.name: Jumbotron Voice
text_block_list.text: "—The future is ours to decide!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Jumbotron Voice
text_block_list.text:
"The story finally hits the silver screen!
Majestic Girls: The Final Chapter!"

text_block_list.name: Jumbotron Voice
text_block_list.text:
"Please, Seiryu! Shishiou!
Fill this sky once more...
with the roar of lightning...!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The Majegal movie...! That's right, it's coming out soon...!
Nishino Flower is cheerfully watching a trailer for an animated movie playing on the outdoor screen—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's an anime called "Majestic Girls," and I heard it was getting a movie adaptation, but—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"It was my first time watching a preview.
I'm so excited... I wonder how it's gonna turn out...!"
choice_data_list: So that's an anime you like.
So that's an anime you like.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a story about a kid around my age
who pilots a robot and fights against giant monsters—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Every week has such thrilling developments...!
The characters are so cute, and the robots are so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"The TV anime ended, but when I heard
the sequel would be a movie,
I've been looking forward to it non-stop...!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry.
Stories like this aren't very interesting, are they...?
Catching a glimpse of an unexpected side to Nishino Flower made me genuinely happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...?
Isn't watching anime
a bit childish...?
choice_data_list: I don't really see it that way.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much.
If you say so, Trainer, then surely...
it's okay for me to just have fun, right!

I nod in agreement. Since we're on the subject,
I want to expand on it more so Nishino Flower
can feel at ease—
choice_data_list: I want to know more about Majegal
I'd love to go see a movie together.
I'd love to go see a movie together.

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...!
Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I really love the two heroines
of MajiGal, Kaede-chan and Mana-chan—
Afterward, I walked back to the academy with Nishino Flower as she happily chatted about MajiGal—
Later on, I promised Nishino Flower that we would watch both the Majestic Girls TV anime and its movie adaptation together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
I'd love to watch it together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... Trainer, have you ever watched the MagiGal TV anime—
choice_data_list: I guess we really should check it out first.
I guess we really should check it out first.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's definitely the better way to go!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I have a recording of it,
would you like to watch it together if you want?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to rewatch it together with you before we see the movie, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, yay♪
Later on, Nishino Flower and I had a great time watching "Majestic Girls" together—

As we chatted together,
we eagerly awaited the movie's premiere.
